narr: An cluster of slow moving, training thundestorms produced torrential rainfall over northern portions of Oakland County on the evening of April 25th. This resulted in a localized area of 2 to 3 inches of rain over Oakland County. The heaviest rain fall between approximtely 4:30pm and 7pm EDT, with light rain continuing through approximately 9pm.
ev: Numerous reports from the public on social media showing water flowing over several roads from Lake Orion to east of Lakeville, and areas south into the Oakland township. One video in particular shows water flowing over 32 Mile east of Lakeville, with active runoff flowing towards and over the road from the higher terrain south of 32 Mile. Oakland Township also had a number of road closures due to flooded roads.
